title: Validate successful LTE Attach and Detach for single UE under excellent radio conditions
preconditions: Single LTE cell activated and unloaded; all other cells powered off
Single UE placed under excellent LTE radio conditions (RSRP as per Clause 4.6)
End-to-end LTE setup operational with no connectivity issues
testSteps: Start logs capture for call flow and signalling messages
Power ON the UE and initiate LTE attach procedure
Wait for successful attach indication (attach request and attach complete messages validated)
Verify UE is attached to the correct LTE cell by checking PCI, Global eNB ID, and ARFCN
Power OFF the UE to initiate LTE detach procedure
Wait for successful detach indication (detach request and detach accept messages validated)
Stop logs capture and save logs for reference
Repeat attach and detach procedures 10 times
expectedResults: Attach success rate is 100% for 10 iterations
Detach success rate is 100% for 10 iterations
Attach latency measured and recorded correctly (minimum, average, maximum)
Logs contain correct signalling flow according to 3GPP TS 23.401 clauses
UE remains attached to the configured LTE cell during tests
commandsUsed: Generic action - Power ON UE
Generic action - Power OFF UE
Generic action - Start and stop logs capture
Generic action - Validate signalling messages in logs
verificationMethods: Analysis of signalling logs for attach/detach messages
Check UE application logs for cell identity confirmation
Measurement of attach latency from logs

Detach success rate including Secondary Node Release is 100% for 10 iterations
Attach latency measured and recorded correctly (minimum, average, maximum)
